title: Hide blog menu from top navigation
body:
Removed the Blog link from the site's top navigation menu.

## Changes

- Commented out Blog navigation item in `apps/docs/app/layout.config.tsx`

```typescript
links: [
  {
    text: 'Documentation',
    url: '/docs/',
    active: 'nested-url',
  },
  // Blog link commented out
],
```
